checks.ref:
command:branch=$(git branch --show-current)
case "$branch" in gnomish/*) task=${branch#gnomish/} ;; *) task=local ;; esac
dir=temporary-docs/gnomish/$task
if [ ! -f "$dir/fix-code.md" ]; then
  echo "no resolution record at $dir/fix-code.md - write it before finishing the round, see .gnomish/stages/fix-code/instructions.md"
  exit 1
fi

command:branch=$(git branch --show-current)
case "$branch" in gnomish/*) task=${branch#gnomish/} ;; *) task=local ;; esac
dir=temporary-docs/gnomish/$task
review=$dir/review-code.md
resolution=$dir/fix-code.md
change=$(sed -n 's/^Change:[[:space:]]*//p' "$dir/change.md" | head -1)
named=$(sed -n 's/^## Audit Resolution:[[:space:]]*//p' "$resolution" | head -1 | tr -d '`')
if [ "$named" != "$change" ]; then
  echo "the resolution's '## Audit Resolution:' heading names '$named', but this task's change is '$change'"
  exit 1
fi
wanted=$(awk 'index($0, "### Recommendations, ordered") == 1 { inside = 1; next } /^##/ { inside = 0 } inside' "$review" \
  | sed -nE 's/^([0-9]+)\. \*\*.*/\1/p' | sort -n)
got=$(sed -nE 's/^### ([0-9]+) — (applied|rejected)[[:space:]]*$/\1/p' "$resolution" | sort -n)
duplicates=$(printf '%s\n' "$got" | uniq -d)
[ -z "$duplicates" ] || { echo "$duplicates"; echo "each recommendation is resolved exactly once - these numbers have two entries"; exit 1; }
if [ "$wanted" != "$got" ]; then
  echo "the audit has recommendations: $(echo $wanted)"
  echo "the resolution resolves:       $(echo $got)"
  echo "give every recommendation of the audit one '### <N> — applied' or '### <N> — rejected' entry, in the audit's numbering"
  exit 1
fi
entries() { awk -v state="$1" '/^### [0-9]+ — / { inside = ($0 ~ (" — " state "[[:space:]]*$")) ; next } /^##/ { inside = 0 } inside' "$resolution"; }
applied=$(grep -cE '^### [0-9]+ — applied' "$resolution" || true)
rejected=$(grep -cE '^### [0-9]+ — rejected' "$resolution" || true)
for field in Recommendation Re-verified Edit; do
  count=$(entries applied | grep -cE "^- $field: " || true)
  [ "$count" = "$applied" ] || { echo "$applied applied entr(ies) but $count '- $field:' line(s) - every applied entry names the recommendation, what you re-verified, and the edit you made"; exit 1; }
done
for field in Recommendation Re-verified Evidence; do
  count=$(entries rejected | grep -cE "^- $field: " || true)
  [ "$count" = "$rejected" ] || { echo "$rejected rejected entr(ies) but $count '- $field:' line(s) - every rejected entry names the recommendation, what you re-verified, and the evidence it fails on"; exit 1; }
done

command:branch=$(git branch --show-current)
case "$branch" in gnomish/*) task=${branch#gnomish/} ;; *) task=local ;; esac
dir=temporary-docs/gnomish/$task
change=$(sed -n 's/^Change:[[:space:]]*//p' "$dir/change.md" | head -1)
forbidden='^(\.claude/|\.gnomish/|openspec/specs/|openspec/changes/archive/)'
dirty=$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all | sed 's/^...//')
committed=""
case "$branch" in
  gnomish/*)
    if base=$(git merge-base origin/main HEAD 2>/dev/null); then
      committed=$(git diff --name-only "$base" HEAD)
    fi
    ;;
esac
touched=$(printf '%s\n%s\n' "$dirty" "$committed" | grep -E "$forbidden" | sort -u || true)
plan=$(printf '%s\n' "$dirty" | grep -E "^openspec/changes/$change/(proposal\.md|design\.md|specs/)" || true)
if [ -n "$touched$plan" ]; then
  echo "the fixes touched paths a fix may not change:"
  printf '%s\n' "$touched" "$plan" | grep .
  echo "undo your edits to these paths. A recommendation that needs the plan, the stable specs or the factory's configuration changed is not fixed in code: reject it with that reason, or escalate through \$GNOMISH_DECISION_FILE."
  exit 1
fi
